subsystems.name: Moisture capture unit
subsystems.role: absorbs water vapour from air using a porous material such as a metal-organic framework (MOF) or desiccant.

subsystems.name: Desorption and condensation
subsystems.role: releases the captured water by heating the material, then condenses the vapour into liquid.
parts: solar thermal collector or electric heater

subsystems.name: Water storage and treatment
subsystems.role: stores water and ensures it is clean enough for irrigation.

subsystems.name: Irrigation system
subsystems.role: delivers water to crops with minimal loss.

subsystems.name: Power supply
subsystems.role: runs fans, heaters, pumps and controls, often off-grid.

subsystems.name: Control and monitoring
subsystems.role: optimises capture and release cycles based on humidity, temperature and solar input.

buildSteps.title: Assess the site
buildSteps.detail: Measure humidity, temperature and solar resource over at least a year to size the system and estimate water yield.

buildSteps.title: Select or synthesise the sorbent
buildSteps.detail: Choose a MOF or desiccant with high water uptake at the local humidity, or procure MOF-coated heat exchangers.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the capture unit
buildSteps.detail: Build ducting and fans that draw air over the sorbent-coated surfaces.

buildSteps.title: Install heating and condensation
buildSteps.detail: Fit solar thermal collectors or electric heaters to release water, and condenser coils to collect it.

buildSteps.title: Connect storage and irrigation
buildSteps.detail: Plumb tanks, pumps and drip lines to deliver water to crops.

buildSteps.title: Set up power and controls
buildSteps.detail: Install solar panels, batteries and a controller that schedules capture cycles.

buildSteps.title: Commission and test
buildSteps.detail: Run repeated cycles, measure water output and quality, and tune the control parameters.

buildSteps.title: Operate and maintain
buildSteps.detail: Monitor performance, clean filters, and replace or regenerate the sorbent as needed.
